label: Вполне
description: A 10-sentence usage card for вполне (quite, fully).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Full satisfaction. 'Вполне' means quite or fully, here marking 'доволен' as completely satisfied. It precedes the predicate to confirm a sufficient degree.
Strategic focus: Reassuring degree. 'Вполне' scales 'нормально' to mean perfectly fine. It conveys that the level reached is entirely acceptable.
Strategic focus: Quite with an ability verb. 'Вполне' modifies 'может' to mean is well able to. It marks the capacity as fully sufficient and stands before the modal verb.
Strategic focus: Sufficiency. 'Вполне' strengthens 'достаточно' to mean quite enough. The pairing is a common, slightly formal way to confirm an adequate amount.
Strategic focus: Moderate praise. 'Вполне' lifts 'приятная' to mean quite pleasant, a measured positive. It precedes the adjective to mark a satisfactory degree.
Strategic focus: Full comprehension. 'Вполне' scales 'понимаю' to mean fully understand. It sits before the verb to signal complete grasp.
Strategic focus: Adjective in a noun phrase. 'Вполне' marks 'разумное' as quite reasonable, and the pair describes 'решение'. The register is neutral to formal.
Strategic focus: Complete state. 'Вполне' raises 'здоров' to mean fully well again. It precedes the predicate to confirm the state is reached in full.
Strategic focus: Measured approval. 'Вполне' scales 'разумная' to mean quite fair, a calm endorsement of the price. It precedes the adjective it modifies.
Strategic focus: Comfortable margin. 'Вполне' modifies 'успеваем' to mean have plenty of time for the train. It marks the action as fully achievable before the verb.
